To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a method of using non- gated QTC to measure the input signals charge was developed for the BES III TOFs readout electronics.
a non-gated charge to time converter was designed and implemented to measure the input PMT signal amplitude for TOF detector.

the designed non-gated QCT with differential inputs is simple, stable, and suitable for multi-channels system, and it helps the TOF system to achieve the expected time-resolution after the time-walking correction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the non-gated QDC (Charge-to-Digital Converter).
the design and test results of the non-gated QDCs for BES III.
the development of the QTC for the TOF readout in the BES III experiment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the designed non-gated QDC (Charge-to-Digital Converter) can measure the input charge of PMT signal with a high precision.
a non-gated charge to time converter has been developed for the BES III TOFs.
the non-gated QCTs developed for BES-III TOF system have achieved the expected performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a non-gated QDC (Charge-to-Digital Converter) with a dynamic range of 30–927  pC was developed and tested, and the results showed the rms resolution was better than 10 bit and the relative error was less than 0,5%.
the non-gated QTD is an effective method to measure the charge of PMT signals, which has been successfully applied to BES III TOFTOF readout electronics.
the non-gated QDC (Charge-to-Digital Converter) is a very good solution for measuring the input charge in high precision time measurement systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have successfully developed a non-gated QPC (Charge-to-Pulse Converter) with differential inputs for BES III.
a simple and effective method to measure the input charges is to use a QTC with differential input and the output of the QTC can be used to correct the time-walk effect.
the non-gated QDC is a very good solution for the charge measurement in the high dynamic range.
